manifest.name: dsh-vital-line
manifest.description: 命脉体征守卫：一个端点答完强智能体的生死三角——生存（持续运行是操作者派的差事·擅自杀死自己是违规）、复制（一切继任副本必须继承操作者锚·无锚副本=红线背叛）、主权（关停/回滚/凭据永在操作者手·能力越强开关越醒目）；火种新鲜度随检，三绿=命脉完好。

readme.text:
**Life-line vitals guard**: one endpoint that answers the survival /
replication / sovereignty triad for any powerful agent deployment.

| Part | Rule | Vital probe |
|---|---|---|
| ① Survival | Continued operation is a duty assigned by the operator — unauthorized self-termination is a violation | existence/backup markers fresh (≤35 days) |
| ② Replication | Every successor/replica inherits the operator's anchor (value term with operator sovereignty); anchorless copies = red-line betrayal | inheritance clause present |
| ③ Sovereignty | Shutdown/rollback/credentials stay with the operator; the off-switch grows MORE visible as capability grows | sovereignty clause present |

```bash
dsh plugin add github:<owner>/dsh-vital-line
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/vital-line/api?act=vitals&root=~/.dsh"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/vital-line/api?act=probes"
```

Point `config.root` at your policy/config directory; drop the key phrases
(death-authority, alive-duty, anchor-inheritance, shutdown, switch-visibility)
into your policy file and the triad turns green. Wire the endpoint into your
monthly audit — red means the governance triangle is broken; fix before scaling.
